contract.structural_score_basis: Axis 5 = CONTRACT & ADMIN, both halves. ⚠️ RE-SCOPED 2026-09-07 from an old-rubric 'Structural 6.5' that spanned THREE axes — it also priced per-pool loan concentration (axis 4) and Maple Labs as an entity (axis 6). A rescoping, not a deterioration; the concentration split that drove the old 6.5 now lives on Dependencies (5.5), where it belongs. ⚠️ THE CODE HALF IS STRONG AND DOES NOT LIFT THE SCORE: audits do not offset an authority path. The number is set by the authority half. ⚠️ THE BINDING FACT IS LIVENESS, NOT KEY THEFT — and the distinction is load-bearing. The `pause` layer resolves to the poolDelegate at on-chain threshold 1 with delay_applies=false over the contract that processes every redemption. ⚠️ BUT MAPLE ATTESTS THESE ARE MPC WALLETS UNDER POLICY CONTROLS (attestation dated 2026-05-04), and that claim is CREDITED here: if it holds, no single private key exists to steal and `threshold: 1` OVERSTATES the compromise cost. ⚠️ IT IS ALSO NOT VERIFIABLE ON-CHAIN — `eth_getCode == 0x` rules OUT a smart-contract multisig but CANNOT distinguish MPC from a single key, since both produce ordinary ECDSA signatures. ⚠️ NEITHER OF THOSE MOVES THE SCORE, BECAUSE THE SCORE DOES NOT REST ON THEFT. It rests on INACTION, which MPC does not touch: `processRedemptions` is `onlyRedeemer`, so NO HOLDER CAN FORCE THEIR OWN EXIT, and any individual holder can be flipped to `isManualWithdrawal` by address. A policy engine Maple configures is not an independent constraint on Maple — it protects the key from a thief, not the holder from the operator's discretion. ⚠️ SECOND: THE MULTISIG PATH IS THE FAST ONE. securityAdmin (Safe 3-of-6) upgrades the PoolManager with delay_applies=false, while the poolDelegate EOA doing the same thing waits 7 days — backwards from how these structures usually read; do not assume the Safe is the conservative route. ⚠️ THIRD: THE 3d GOVERNANCE DELAY IS A DETECTION WINDOW, NOT A GATE — a role update is the one proposal class the CANCELLER may not cancel, so ROLE_ADMIN can schedule a grant of every role to itself and wait three days in the open. ✅ CREDITED AND CAPPED: every upgrade routes through factory.upgradeInstance and registerImplementation is onlyGovernor, so the undelayed 3-of-6 reaches a Maple-PUBLISHED implementation — a rollback, not arbitrary code. That cap plus the audit corpus is why this is 4.5 and not lower. ⚠️ IDENTICAL ON BOTH SYRUP POOLS BY MEASUREMENT, not by assumption: security_analyst's 2026-09-06 hand-walk returns the same six ethereum paths with the same thresholds and the same delay_applies on syrupUSDC and syrupUSDT. They share MapleGlobals, governor, securityAdmin, the 4-of-7 pool-permission Safe, the manager implementation and the factory; only the delegate EOA address differs. A per-asset difference here would be scoring something that is not there.
